description: Create a tag on a connected WordPress site and return {id, name, slug, created}; created=false means a tag with that name already existed (no duplicate is made). Use the id in create_post tags. 403 means the WordPress user connected to Flomixy may not create tags (WORDPRESS_TERM_CREATE_FORBIDDEN). Requires scope ACCOUNTS_WRITE (a key issued before that scope existed must be re-issued).

accountId.description: The WordPress site account id (list_accounts, channel WORDPRESS).

name.description: Tag name, 1-200 characters. An existing name (case-insensitive) is returned as is, never duplicated.

name: create_wordpress_tag
title: Create WordPress tag
